reviews.review_title: Brings back oh so much good times
reviews.review_description: Vr has been widely classified as dead for quite some time now, however this game alone has been rising vr back up the charts and giving it life once more. My thankfulness to this game knows no bounds as I have been able to relive those g-tag days. Back when you would get home and play vr while on call with a friend. I had believed those days long lost before this game as it has allowed me to connect with so many people and make many new friends. Geez, you just know a game is good if you can write this much without even having to stop and think about how many positives this has brought gaming. Without a second thought I would say this has been the most fun I’ve had on vr in years. Please if ANY devs are reading this continue working on this masterpiece as it hopefully brings light to many other households as it has my own. Thank you for letting me see prime vr make a return.
